review_notes: I read the whole file and compared it with Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Preadditive/Yoneda/Basic.lean. Its whiskering_preadditiveYoneda and whiskering_preadditiveCoyoneda lemmas are also @[simp] and proved by rfl, so the four whiskering_linear* lemmas follow the same convention. Their left-hand sides are whole functor compositions, so they don't compete with the @[simps] projection lemmas for linearYoneda and linearCoyoneda. Those lemmas have constructor-headed right-hand sides, so the rewrite direction is not a problem. Rewriting a composite back to `yoneda` or `preadditiveYoneda` shrinks the term, so I see no credible loop. A grep of Mathlib for downstream uses found only the two internal uses in the faithfulness instances. I found no concrete missing simp lemma, competing rule or cycle. I did not run Lean, so I may have missed a simp-set interaction that only shows up there.
